supportPage.title: Get help with Tutor Compass
supportPage.emailAfter: and say which page you were on and what went wrong.
supportPage.owner: The owner of your tutoring business manages Tutor Compass and everyone's accounts. Contact them directly for help.
supportPage.tip1: Check the email address for typing mistakes. Passwords are case sensitive.
supportPage.tip2After: to get a reset link by email.
supportPage.tip3: Just created an account? Confirm your email first. Then the owner needs to give you access in Approval Alley before you can sign in.
supportPage.tip4: Used Apple, Google or Microsoft? The owner still needs to give that account access the first time.
supportPage.wrongHeading: Something looks wrong with a request?
supportPage.wrong: Open the request and use the full record at the bottom of the page. It shows the rule that was applied, the facts used and every change. Send the request number (for example BK-1042) to the owner.

privacyPage.intro: Tutor Compass is a student project built for a university course. Each tutoring business that uses it runs its own copy, and that business decides what is stored and who can see it. This page explains what the app itself collects and why.
privacyPage.store1: Your account: your name, email address and whether you are an admin or the owner.
privacyPage.store2: Requests you enter, such as refunds, lesson changes and payment extensions, with the facts, the rule that was applied and the outcome.
privacyPage.store3: A history of who did what on each request, so decisions can be checked later.
privacyPage.store4: Your chosen language, so the site opens in it next time.
privacyPage.storeWhere: This is kept in the business's own Supabase database. The demonstration families, bookings and payments are fictional.
privacyPage.cookies: Two cookies keep you signed in, and short-lived ones are used while you confirm an email or reset a password. Your browser's scripts can't read them. There are no advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser also keeps your Compass AI conversation for that tab only, and forgets it when the tab is closed.
privacyPage.cookiesLanguage: If you choose a language before signing in, one more cookie remembers it on this device. It holds only the language code. Display settings such as text size are kept in your browser's storage on this device.
privacyPage.services1: Supabase stores the database and handles sign-in.
privacyPage.services2: If the business turns on live AI, the text you give Compass AI or paste into a request is sent to Anthropic to read it. Without that setting, nothing is sent and the assistant runs in a labelled demo mode.
privacyPage.services3: If you sign in with Apple, Google or Microsoft, that company shares your name and email with the app.
privacyPage.services4: Voice input uses your browser's own speech recognition, which may send audio to the browser maker.
privacyPage.services5: Changing the language never sends your records anywhere. The site's own text is translated in advance, and names, notes and messages stay as they were written.
privacyPage.choices: Ask the owner of your business to correct your details or remove your account. Keep the information you enter to what a request needs, especially about students.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.intro: Tutor Compass is a student project built for a university course. It is provided as it is, and it may change.
termsPage.who: Only people the owner of the business has given access. Keep your password to yourself and sign out on shared computers.
termsPage.whatHeading: What it does and doesn't do
termsPage.what1: It checks each request against the rules the owner has set and shows the reason for the outcome.
termsPage.what2: It doesn't move money, issue refunds or change bookings. You still do those in your own systems, then record what you did.
termsPage.what3: Compass AI can prepare drafts and suggestions. Check them before using them. The owner's rules decide the outcome, not the AI.
termsPage.what4: Translations of the site's own text are provided to help. If a translation and the English differ, the English wording applies.
termsPage.safety: Safety and welfare concerns always go to the owner. If someone is in danger, contact emergency services first.
termsPage.advice: Nothing in Tutor Compass is legal or financial advice. The owner stays responsible for the business's decisions.
